description: This file defines the class DefaultLazyPluginCollection, which manages a collection of plugins with lazy instantiation, including sorting, configuration, and plugin management functionalities within Drupal.

classes.name: DefaultLazyPluginCollection
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of plugins with lazy loading, sorting, and configuration management, used within Drupal's plugin system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin collection with a plugin manager and optional configurations.

methods.name: initializePlugin
methods.description: Creates and sets a plugin instance based on its ID and configuration.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the plugin instances in the collection.

methods.name: sortHelper
methods.description: Helper function for sorting plugins based on their plugin IDs.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin ID for a given plugin instance ID.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration of all plugin instances.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for multiple plugin instances.

methods.name: setInstanceConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the configuration for a specific plugin instance, re-instantiating if necessary.

methods.name: addInstanceId
methods.description: Adds a new plugin instance ID with optional configuration.

methods.name: removeInstanceId
methods.description: Removes a plugin instance ID from the collection.
